warnings: Alternative F1 for sites where the prestressed piles cannot be driven (notes item 7: ให้ทำฐานรากแผ่ ทั้งนี้ต้องได้รับอนุมัติจากผู้มีอำนาจก่อน). Same mark F1 as the governing pile cap, so it is kept in its own file to avoid an element_id collision; the plan does not say which positions use it.

Plan 1.50 (0.75 + 0.75) x 1.90 (0.95 + 0.95) — not square, so depth_mm is given. Section 1-1 prints the thickness as '0.30' at the edge with '0.10' above it (the sloped top rising to the pedestal): height_mm = 400 at the pedestal face, 300 at the edge, both kept in printed_as.
Bars '11-Ø15 มม. ด้านยาว' and '16-Ø15 มม. ด้านสั้น' — count = 27 (11 + 16), printed text kept; which direction each set runs is as printed, not re-interpreted.
Underside 1.20 below ระดับดินเดิม ±0.00; 0.05 cover, lean concrete 1:3:5 0.10, ทรายหยาบอัดแน่น 0.10.
